name: Appointment reminder (email)
subject: Your appointment on {{context.appointmentDate}}
content:
Hi {{recipient.firstName}},

This is a reminder of your appointment on {{context.appointmentDate}} with {{context.doctorName}}.

If you need to reschedule, just reply to this message.

{{tenant.name}}

name: Appointment reminder (SMS)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:145-160. Same two variables, shorter body.
content: Reminder: your appointment with {{context.doctorName}} is on {{context.appointmentDate}}. Reply to reschedule. — {{tenant.name}}

name: Appointment confirmation (email)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:171-185. Spreads the whole appointmentDetails object.
subject: Your appointment is confirmed

name: Appointment cancellation (email)
subject: Your appointment has been cancelled

name: Appointment cancellation (SMS)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:214-229. NARROWER than the email: the source passes only appointmentDate and location here, not the whole details object.
content: Your appointment on {{context.appointmentDate}}{{#if context.location}} at {{context.location}}{{/if}} has been cancelled. Reply to rebook. — {{tenant.name}}

name: Appointment rescheduling (email)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:240-259. Flattens oldAppointment/newAppointment into oldDate, oldTime, newDate, newTime, location, provider.
subject: Your appointment has moved to {{context.newDate}}

name: Appointment rescheduling (SMS)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:263-279. Narrower again: oldDate, newDate, newTime only.
content: Your appointment has moved from {{context.oldDate}} to {{context.newDate}}{{#if context.newTime}} at {{context.newTime}}{{/if}}. — {{tenant.name}}
